Entry 01 · The Route

Nagpur → Lille → Nagpur → Bhubaneswar.

Every entry in this journal is pinned to a place and a date. Follow the route line as it fills in — the same way the journey unfolded.

Nagpur · 2021 — 2024

The Foundation — BBA, Symbiosis International University

Nagpur, India

I earned my Bachelor of Business Administration with a CGPA of 8.37/10, focusing on business strategy, operations, and digital marketing — while staying active in the university's co-curricular club. This is where I learned to think in systems.

Lille · Jan — Jun 2023

The Immersion — Exchange, IESEG School of Management

Lille, France

I spent a semester in France completing cross-cultural management coursework at a leading European business school. Living and learning abroad rewired how I lead across cultures — and started my love affair with the French language.

Nagpur · 2024 — 2026

The Build — Operations, Growth & Ownership

Nagpur, India

Returning to Nagpur, I stopped observing business and started running it.

HR & Operations Intern — UPAY India (Remote)

Apr 2024 — Oct 2024

I managed full-cycle recruitment for 100+ candidates and improved onboarding coordination — practical experience in planning, stakeholder communication, process execution and people operations.

Strategy Associate & Stakeholder — Aranya Wildlife OPC Pvt. Ltd.

Oct 2024 — 2026

I helped open the company's first international client channel, developed B2B partnerships with premium resorts, coordinated stakeholders and contributed to ₹10L+ in new revenue — combining strategy with hands-on execution as a company stakeholder.

Digital Marketing & Analytics — IIM Mumbai × Masai

2025 — 2026 · Professional Certification

Completed 5+ live strategy and analytics projects, including a process-redesign exercise that delivered a measurable 15% efficiency gain.

Bhubaneswar · 2026 — 2028

The Next Chapter — MBA, Xavier Institute of Management

Bhubaneswar, India · Batch of 2028

I am currently pursuing my MBA in Business Management at XIM Bhubaneswar — sharpening strategy, finance, and leadership lenses, and bringing real operator experience into every case room.

Entry 04 · The Stakehold

A live case study in ownership.

Aranya Wildlife is one of the clearest examples of how I work across functions. My contribution spans strategy, partnerships, stakeholder coordination, business development, communication and execution — helping open an international client channel and build premium B2B resort relationships around a conservation-rooted venture.

The experience is broader than a single job title: it requires commercial judgement, project coordination, client communication, prioritisation and ownership — capabilities that transfer directly into project, strategy, operations and growth roles.

"Ownership means staying with the outcome — from idea, to stakeholder, to execution."

Field Context
Field Context · Tadoba

Where business meets a real ecosystem.

Tadoba–Andhari Tiger Reserve in Chandrapur district, Maharashtra, is one of the landscapes that gives Aranya Wildlife its real-world context. It is not included here as decoration: it represents the operating environment behind responsible wildlife travel, guest experience, local relationships and conservation-sensitive communication.

For recruiters outside the wildlife sector, the transferable lesson is project complexity. Different stakeholders, uncertain conditions, customer expectations, partner coordination and reputation all have to work together — the same fundamentals found in strong project and operations roles.

StakeholdersGuests · partners · local ecosystem
